rationale: Steven is building brain-inspired personal AI agents with a focus on private, local-first systems, while Tom is developing humanoid robotics at Ruyi Dynamics—two hardware/embodiment-adjacent frontiers where AI agents could become tangible products. Steven's deep technical background in TypeScript, Rust, and protocol design, paired with Tom's robotics expertise, could spark conversations about embodied AI or agent-robot integration, though their current projects operate in distinct domains.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Tom Zhanh—you're both building next-generation embodied AI systems (personal agents and humanoid robotics) and might find common ground on how local, private AI could power physical applications.
